# Lunar Rails Consultancy

> Compliance-first advisory for firms operating in digital assets. Regulatory guidance and cost intelligence, structured for action.

Lunar Rails Consultancy LTD is the advisory arm of the Lunar Rails group. Licensed in Ras Al Khaimah under the RAK Digital Assets Oasis Authority (License 07010347). A subsidiary of OTC Services DMCC.

## What We Do

We provide structured advisory services to virtual asset businesses operating in regulated environments. We do not offer generalist advice. Every engagement is scoped around measurable outcomes.

### Regulatory and Compliance
Jurisdiction mapping, licensing strategy, and compliance frameworks for virtual asset service providers. Services include: licensing and jurisdiction strategy, AML/CFT program design, regulatory reporting support, and policy documentation.

### Cost Control and Financial Intelligence
Operational cost modelling, fee benchmarking, and data-driven reporting frameworks. Services include: cost modelling and benchmarking, KPI design and reporting frameworks, spend rationalization, and financial dashboards.

## Who We Work With

Virtual asset firms, digital asset service providers, and financial institutions that need clear regulatory positioning and tighter operational cost control in the UAE and international markets.

## Our Differentiation

- Data-driven methodology: every recommendation is grounded in quantitative analysis
- Regulatory depth: active RAK DAO licensing and real jurisdictional knowledge
- Implementation focus: we deliver policy documents, operational frameworks, and reporting tools that work from day one

## Entity Details

- Full name: Lunar Rails Consultancy LTD
- License: 07010347
- Regulator: RAK Digital Assets Oasis Authority (RAK DAO)
- Jurisdiction: Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
